# Verifies `dump --stage lowered --list` succeeds for every shipping platform.
# InlinePure runs always-on, and a platform-package override must inline to
# declared primitives or the build fails.
#
# NoAsyncCalls is on every Go target, because Go cannot suspend a function.
# AsyncPost is on the two that can get back to the thread they draw on, and
# bubbletea's absence from that list is why the same program it takes here is
# refused as soon as it contains a blocking call -- see go_async_no_post.txt.

sngl dump --stage lowered --lang go --platform bubbletea --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: NoTernary,NoAsyncReactive,NoAsyncCalls,NoListLambdas,StructComponents,StdlibContextParam,NoInlineComponents,NoStructSpread,NoImplicitRecv,FocusOrder,Canvas'
stdout 'passes: RootWindow → HoistState → ForeignPrimitive → PlatformExtensionBody → PropBindings → RefLoop → ViewForElse → Query → NoAsyncReactive → NoListLambdas → Context → InlinePure → NoInlineComponents → WindowNesting → RecursionDepth → NoStructSpread → NoImplicitRecv → Canvas → Effect → NoTernary → FocusOrder → NoAsyncCalls'

# fyne and gtk4 carry ComponentProps and InstanceBodies for the same reason
# html does: a component the build cannot inline is built as a record with its
# own state. Their capabilities are identical, so the gate cannot tell them
# apart and neither can this list.
#
# SlotChildInstances is the one that does tell them apart, and html is the only
# target with it. It gates on InsertBefore as well, because retaining a slot
# child buys the placement match and nothing else -- a container that only
# appends tears its children down every render, so there is no identity for
# anything to ask about.
sngl dump --stage lowered --lang go --platform fyne --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: NoTernary,NoAsyncReactive,NoAsyncCalls,AsyncPost,NoListLambdas,StructComponents,StdlibContextParam,NoReactivity,NoInlineComponents,NoStructSpread,NoDeclarative,Canvas'
stdout 'passes: RootWindow → HoistState → ForeignPrimitive → PlatformExtensionBody → PropBindings → RefLoop → ViewForElse → Query → NoAsyncReactive → NoListLambdas → Context → InlinePure → NoInlineComponents → WindowNesting → RecursionDepth → NoStructSpread → Canvas → Effect → InstanceEvents → ComponentProps → NoReactivity → NoTernary → CanvasReactivity → InstanceBodies → NoDeclarative → NodeEscape → NoAsyncCalls'

# html emits HTML and JS; the language emits only the server half of route
# mode. So a restriction that exists because the language lacks a construct is
# not html's -- NoTernary and NoListLambdas are absent here for the same reason
# they are absent under --lang none, even though Go asks for both. html+go and
# html+none now lower identically.
sngl dump --stage lowered --lang go --platform html --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: NoAsyncReactive,StructComponents,StdlibContextParam,NoReactivity,NoInlineComponents,NoStructSpread,NoImplicitRecv,Canvas'
stdout 'passes: RootWindow → HoistState → ForeignPrimitive → PlatformExtensionBody → PropBindings → RefLoop → ViewForElse → Query → NoAsyncReactive → Context → InlinePure → NoInlineComponents → WindowNesting → RecursionDepth → NoStructSpread → NoImplicitRecv → Canvas → Effect → SlotChildInstances → InstanceEvents → ComponentProps → NoReactivity → CanvasReactivity → InstanceBodies'

sngl dump --stage lowered --lang none --platform html --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: NoAsyncReactive,StructComponents,StdlibContextParam,NoReactivity,NoInlineComponents,NoStructSpread,NoImplicitRecv,Canvas'
stdout 'passes: RootWindow → HoistState → ForeignPrimitive → PlatformExtensionBody → PropBindings → RefLoop → ViewForElse → Query → NoAsyncReactive → Context → InlinePure → NoInlineComponents → WindowNesting → RecursionDepth → NoStructSpread → NoImplicitRecv → Canvas → Effect → SlotChildInstances → InstanceEvents → ComponentProps → NoReactivity → CanvasReactivity → InstanceBodies'

sngl dump --stage lowered --lang go --platform gtk4 --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: NoTernary,NoAsyncReactive,NoAsyncCalls,AsyncPost,NoListLambdas,StructComponents,StdlibContextParam,NoReactivity,NoInlineComponents,NoStructSpread,NoDeclarative,Canvas'
stdout 'passes: RootWindow → HoistState → ForeignPrimitive → PlatformExtensionBody → PropBindings → RefLoop → ViewForElse → Query → NoAsyncReactive → NoListLambdas → Context → InlinePure → NoInlineComponents → WindowNesting → RecursionDepth → NoStructSpread → Canvas → Effect → InstanceEvents → ComponentProps → NoReactivity → NoTernary → CanvasReactivity → InstanceBodies → NoDeclarative → NodeEscape → NoAsyncCalls'

# android is the one target with no Effect pass: Compose brackets a keyed
# lifetime itself, so it asks for the node (Features.Effects) rather than the
# calls the pass would lower it to.
sngl dump --stage lowered --lang kotlin --platform android --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: StructComponents,StdlibContextParam,NoInlineComponents,NoStructSpread,Canvas'
stdout 'passes: RootWindow → HoistState → ForeignPrimitive → PlatformExtensionBody → PropBindings → RefLoop → ViewForElse → Query → Context → InlinePure → NoInlineComponents → WindowNesting → RecursionDepth → NoStructSpread → Canvas → IndexedIter → ForElse → CSE → IterKind'

# Unknown pass name surfaces a non-zero exit.
! sngl dump --stage lowered --lang go --platform bubbletea --after NoBogus main.sngl

-- main.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component main {
    text(value="hello")
}
